reports.name: Yr34
reports.evidence: Fig. 1 and Results: gene order Xgwm595 – Xgwm6a – Xgwm291 – Xgwm410.2 – B1 – Yr34; Yr34 12.2 cM distal to the awn inhibitor B1 (WAWHT2046/Carnamah DH, n = 116)
reports.note: Seedling (IT 23C) and adult-plant (10R-MR) stripe rust resistance from WAWHT2046 (donor AUS22857), originally YrWA. All SSRs map proximal to B1; Yr34 is distal to B1 (12.2 cM), so it lies between the cloned B1 gene (TraesCS5A02G542800, 700.825 Mb on RefSeq v2.1; 698.529 Mb on v1.0) and the distal end of 5AL. The interval runs from B1 to the last annotated gene of 5A (713.328 Mb). Hand-curated from the original paper, Nov 2026 (ad63). Supersedes V2238 and K0214, which placed Yr34 at the proximal marker Xgwm410.

reports.name: Stripe rust locus, A. cristatum 6PS (0.81–1.00)
reports.marker: 29 6P-specific STS markers (e.g. Agc4527, Agc37790, Agc21670, Agc2970)
reports.evidence: Table 1, Table 4, Fig. 6: resistant lines carry 6PS (0.53–1.00), (0.59–1.00), (0.81–1.00) and (0.86–1.00); deletions retaining 6PS (0.00–0.81) are susceptible; locus assigned to bin 6PS (0.81–1.00) of WAT655
reports.note: Alien locus from Agropyron cristatum (accession Z559) chromosome 6P, located on the terminal part of 6PS (fraction length 0.81–1.00) with wheat–A. cristatum translocation and deletion lines (GISH and 6P-specific STS markers); effective against Pst races CYR32 and CYR33. Line WAT655 carries the segment as a compensating 6DS·6DL-6PS translocation (recorded here on 6D); WAT646 carries 6PS (0.86–1.00) on 1BS (1BL·1BS-6PS). The locus is on an alien chromosome with no RefSeq coordinates, so it is kept as a bin-only record and not drawn. Hand-curated from the original paper, Nov 2026 (ad63).

reports.name: Yr34
reports.note: Rust resistance locus compiled and anchored to IWGSC RefSeq v2.1 by Tong et al. (2024), Table S2. Original study: Bariana et al. 2006; donor WAWHT2046. The compilation gives a single anchor point, not an interval. Superseded Nov 2026 (ad63): Bariana et al. (2006) place Yr34 distal to the awn inhibitor B1, not at Xgwm410; see record NK0001 (hand-curated from the original paper). Kept as a bin-only record so the compilation entry is not drawn twice.
reports.evidence: Reported name Yr34; marker Xgwm410; 5A 660.734889 Mb
